Regarding need to establish a SAI sub-centre in Khajuraho and a Khelo India Centre in Panna in Madhya Pradesh-laid

श्री विष्णु दत्त शर्मा (खजुराहो) : मैं सरकार का ध्यान बुंदेलखंड के दो महत्वपूर्ण क्षेत्रों?खजुराहो (छतरपुर) और पन्ना में गंभीर रूप से उपेक्षित खेल अवसंरचना की ओर आकर्षित करना चाहता हूँ । खजुराहो से निकटतम SAI प्रशिक्षण केंद्र भोपाल/जबलपुर 250?370 किमी दूर है, जिससे नियमित वैज्ञानिक प्रशिक्षण लगभग असंभव हो जाता है । इसके बावजूद स्थानीय क्रिकेटर क्रांति गौड़ ने सीमित साधनों में राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर पहचान बनाई है । यह इस क्षेत्र की अपार क्षमता का स्पष्ट प्रमाण है । पन्ना जिले में बाल एवं युवा जनसंख्या का अनुपात अत्यधिक है और कबड्डी, हॉकी, एथलेटिक्स जैसे खेलों में असाधारण प्रतिभा उपलब्ध है, परंतु अब तक न तो यहाँ Khelo India Centre स्थापित हुआ है, न ही किसी राष्ट्रीय खेल अकादमी की दिशा में प्रगति हुई है, जबकि SAI और Khelo India की नीतियाँ ग्रामीण प्रतिभा को प्राथमिकता देती हैं । अतः मैं सरकार से आग्रह करता हूँ कि खजुराहो में SAI उप?केंद्र तथा पन्ना में Khelo India Centre/राष्ट्रीय खेल अकादमी की स्थापना पर तत्काल और समयबद्ध निर्णय लिया जाए, ताकि इस क्षेत्र की प्रतिभा को उचित मंच मिल सके ।
records.ls|LS18_S8_6903:
Regarding need to expedite completion of the proposed Airport at Samithoppu, Kanniyakumari, Tamil Nadu-laid

SHRI VIJAYAKUMAR ALIAS VIJAY VASANTH (KANYAKUMARI): I would like to urge the Union Government to expedite the establishment of the proposed airport at Samithoppu in Kanniyakumari district. This long-pending project is of immense importance to the people of the southernmost region of our country. Kanniyakumari is a globally renowned tourist destination, attracting millions of domestic and international visitors every year. It is also an important centre for education, healthcare, fisheries, agriculture and renewable energy. However, the absence of an airport within the district limits continues to hinder its economic and tourism potential. An airport at Samithoppu will provide faster and more convenient connectivity, promote tourism, generate employment opportunities, attract investments and support the export of marine products, agricultural produce and other local industries. It will also greatly benefit students, businesspersons, pilgrims and patients who currently travel long distances to reach the nearest airports. The project will contribute significantly to the balanced development of southern Tamil Nadu and strengthen regional connectivity under the Government's vision of improving transport infrastructure across the country. I therefore earnestly request the Hon'ble Minister to accord priority to the proposed airport at Samithoppu, complete all necessary clearances at the earliest and ensure the speedy implementation of this long-awaited project.

श्री मुरारी लाल मीना (दौसा) : वर्तमान में भारतीय रेलवे द्वारा मासिक सीजन टिकट (एमएसटी) की सुविधा अधिकतम 150 किलोमीटर तक ही उपलब्ध है । यह व्यवस्था उस समय बनाई गई थी, जब अधिकांश रेलमार्ग मीटर गेज अथवा डीजल चालित थे । आज अधिकांश रेलमार्ग ब्रॉडगेज एवं पूर्णतः विद्युतीकृत हो चुके हैं तथा ट्रेनों की गति और परिचालन क्षमता में उल्लेखनीय वृद्धि हुई है । ऐसे में एमएसटी की वर्तमान दूरी सीमा व्यावहारिक नहीं रह गई है । मेरे संसदीय क्षेत्र दौसा तथा बांदीकुई सहित आसपास के क्षेत्रों से प्रतिदिन सैकड़ों लोग दिल्ली एवं गुरुग्राम में सरकारी, निजी एवं औद्योगिक प्रतिष्ठानों में कार्य करने हेतु रेल से यात्रा करते हैं । वर्तमान दूरी के कारण उन्हें महानगरों में किराये पर रहने के लिए विवश होना पड़ता है । यदि एमएसटी की अधिकतम दूरी 150 किलोमीटर से बढ़ाकर 250 किलोमीटर कर दी जाए, तो वे प्रतिदिन अपने गृह नगर से सुरक्षित एवं किफायती आवागमन कर सकेंगे । इससे दिल्ली-एनसीआर जैसे महानगरों पर आवासीय दबाव कम होगा । अतः यात्रियों की वर्तमान आवश्यकताओं एवं बदलती रेल अवसंरचना को ध्यान में रखते हुए मासिक सीजन टिकट (एमएसटी) की अधिकतम दूरी सीमा 150 किलोमीटर से बढ़ाकर 250 किलोमीटर करने का निर्णय शीघ्र लिया जाए, ताकि देशभर के लाखों दैनिक यात्रियों को इसका प्रत्यक्ष लाभ मिल सके ।
records.ls|LS18_S8_6905:
Regarding reported abrupt retrenchment of employees in CorroHealth company in Kerala-laid

SHRI SHAFI PARAMBIL (VADAKARA): I would like to draw the attention of the Government to the growing incidence of large-scale layoffs in the Information Technology (IT) sector, which has created deep insecurity among thousands of young professionals across the country. The latest reported instance is the abrupt retrenchment of around 800 employees at CorroHealth's Kochi center, causing severe hardship to the affected workers and their families. Similar layoffs by several IT companies in recent months have raised serious concerns about the absence of adequate safeguards for employees against sudden termination of employment. The IT sector has been one of India's largest contributors to economic growth, exports, and employment. However, increasing instances of mass retrenchment, often without sufficient notice, consultation, or rehabilitation measures, undermine the confidence of the workforce and adversely affect the country's skilled human capital. I urge the Government to examine the recent layoffs, including the reported retrenchment at CorroHealth, ascertain whether all applicable labour and legal provisions have been complied with, and take appropriate action wherever violations are found. I also request the Government to evolve a comprehensive policy framework to regulate large-scale layoffs, strengthen social security, promote re-skilling and re-employment, and protect the rights and dignity of employees in the IT sector.

श्री उम्मेदा राम बेनीवाल (बाड़मेर) : मैं बाड़मेर लोकसभा क्षेत्र अंतर्गत बाड़मेर-जैसलमेर क्षेत्र के भारत?पाकिस्तान अंतरराष्ट्रीय सीमा से लगे गांवों के निवासियों की गंभीर समस्या की ओर सदन तथा सरकार का ध्यान आकर्षित करना चाहता हूँ । केंद्र सरकार 'वाइब्रेंट विलेज प्रोग्राम' के माध्यम से सीमावर्ती क्षेत्रों में आधारभूत सुविधाओं के विकास, जनसंख्या को बनाए रखने तथा पर्यटन को प्रोत्साहित करने की बात करती है, वहीं दूसरी ओर सुरक्षा संबंधी प्रतिबंधों और प्रशासनिक कार्रवाइयों के कारण वर्षों से अपनी भूमि पर निवास कर रहे अनेक परिवार विस्थापन की आशंका का सामना कर रहे हैं । ये परिवार दशकों से सीमा की सुरक्षा में अप्रत्यक्ष सहयोगी रहे हैं तथा सीमांत क्षेत्रों में भारत की उपस्थिति को सुदृढ़ बनाए रखते आए हैं । अतः मैं सरकार से आग्रह करता हूँ कि बाड़मेर?जैसलमेर के सीमावर्ती निवासियों के लिए विशेष सुरक्षा-सह-पुनर्वास नीति बनाई जाए, जिससे राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा की आवश्यकताओं और स्थानीय नागरिकों के अधिकारों के बीच संतुलन स्थापित हो । यदि किसी कारणवश विस्थापन अपरिहार्य हो, तो प्रभावित परिवारों को सम्मानजनक पुनर्वास, उचित मुआवजा, आजीविका, शिक्षा तथा अन्य मूलभूत सुविधाएँ सुनिश्चित की जाएँ, ताकि देश के इन सजग सीमांत प्रहरियों को अपनी ही भूमि पर असुरक्षा और विस्थापन का सामना न करना पड़े ।
records.ls|LS18_S8_6907:
Regarding need to retain Kondapalli-Motamarri Railway Section alongwith Madhira Railway station under South-Central Railway Zone-laid

SHRI RAMASAHAYAM RAGHURAM REDDY (KHAMMAM): There is growing public opposition to the proposal of transferring the Kondapalli?Motamarri railway section, including Madhira Railway Station, from the South-Central Railway (SCR) to the newly announced South Coast Railway (SCoR) Zone. Madhira Railway Station, located in Telangana, has experienced significant development under the administration of SCR through improved connectivity, better infrastructure, punctual train operations, and increased stoppages of important passenger and express trains. The administrative control of SCR from Secunderabad has ensured efficient coordination, timely decision-making, and prompt resolution of passenger grievances. Shifting this railway section to SCoR, headquartered at Visakhapatnam, may lead to administrative delays, reduced attention to local requirements, and diversion of resources away from Telangana. Residents fear that the transfer could gradually weaken SCR?s presence in the region and adversely affect train services relied upon by thousands of passengers travelling to Hyderabad, Khammam, Vijayawada, and other important destinations. In view of these concerns, it is strongly requested that the Ministry of Railways withdraw the proposed transfer and retain Madhira, Motamarri, and Errupalem Railway Stations, along with the railway line up to the territorial jurisdiction of Khammam district in Telangana, under the South-Central Railway Zone to safeguard regional interests and ensure uninterrupted, passenger-friendly railway services.
records.ls|LS18_S8_6908:
Regarding need to establish an AIIMS or a super speciality hospital in Sambhal district, Uttar Pradesh-laid

श्री जिया उर रहमान (सम्भल) : मैं सरकार का ध्यान अपने लोकसभा क्षेत्र सम्भल में उन्नत स्वास्थ्य सुविधाओं के अभाव की ओर आकर्षित करना चाहता हूँ । आज भी AIIMS अथवा सुपर स्पेशियलिटी अस्पताल जैसी कोई सुविधा उपलब्ध नहीं है । गंभीर बीमारियों से पीड़ित मरीजों को उपचार के लिए दिल्ली, अलीगढ़, मुरादाबाद अथवा अन्य शहरों में जाना पड़ता है, जिससे समय, धन एवं जीवन?तीनों पर प्रतिकूल प्रभाव पड़ता है । सम्भल एवं आसपास के क्षेत्रों में हृदय रोग, कैंसर, न्यूरोलॉजी, किडनी तथा ट्रॉमा के मरीजों को विशेषज्ञ उपचार के लिए दूर-दराज़ के अस्पतालों पर निर्भर रहना पड़ता है । इससे विशेष रूप से गरीब एवं ग्रामीण परिवारों को भारी कठिनाइयों का सामना करना पड़ता है । अतः मैं सरकार से आग्रह करता हूँ कि सम्भल जनपद में AIIMS अथवा एक सुपर स्पेशियलिटी अस्पताल की स्थापना की जाए, ताकि सम्भल एवं आसपास के जनपदों के लोगों को स्थानीय स्तर पर ही गुणवत्तापूर्ण एवं सुलभ स्वास्थ्य सेवाएँ उपलब्ध हो सकें ।
records.ls|LS18_S8_6909:
Regarding need to deploy adequate staff in branches of nationalised banks in Kairana town in Shamli district and establish a branch of nationalized bank in Kiwana village in the district-laid

सुश्री इकरा चौधरी (कैराना) : मैं अपने लोकसभा क्षेत्र कैराना के अंतर्गत जनपद शामली की एक महत्वपूर्ण जनसमस्या की ओर सरकार का ध्यान आकर्षित करना चाहती हूँ । नगर कैराना में पंजाब नेशनल बैंक, केनरा बैंक तथा भारतीय स्टेट बैंक की शाखाएँ संचालित हैं, परंतु खाताधारकों की संख्या के अनुपात में स्टाफ अत्यंत कम है । इससे ग्राहकों को लंबी प्रतीक्षा करनी पड़ती है और नकद लेन-देन, किसान ऋण, पेंशन, डीबीटी तथा अन्य सेवाएँ प्रभावित होती हैं । किसानों, महिलाओं, वरिष्ठ नागरिकों और ग्रामीण उपभोक्ताओं को भारी असुविधा होती है । साथ ही, विकासखंड कांधला का ग्राम किवाना एक बड़ा और आर्थिक रूप से महत्वपूर्ण गाँव है, जहाँ अनेक ईंट-भट्टे संचालित हैं, फिर भी वहाँ किसी राष्ट्रीयकृत बैंक की शाखा नहीं है । ग्रामीणों, भट्ठा स्वामियों और श्रमिकों को दूरस्थ गाँवों में जाना पड़ता है । अतः अनुरोध है कि कैराना की बैंक शाखाओं में पर्याप्त अतिरिक्त स्टाफ तैनात किया जाए तथा ग्राम किवाना में राष्ट्रीयकृत बैंक की नई शाखा स्थापित की जाए ।
records.ls|LS18_S8_6910:
Regarding need to ensure conducting Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in the country in transparent and neutral manner-laid

PROF. SOUGATA RAY (DUM DUM): The concerns expressed by certain UN Special Rapporteurs regarding the ongoing SIR of electoral rolls in the country. The Rapporteurs have reportedly raised issues relating to the potential exclusion of eligible voters, stringent documentation requirements, lack of adequate procedural safeguards, possibility of disenfranchisement of vulnerable sections, including migrant workers, women, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, minorities, elderly citizens and economically weaker sections. The right to vote is the cornerstone of a democratic republic and any revision of electoral rolls must be conducted in a transparent, inclusive, non-discriminatory and the constitutional guarantee of universal adult suffrage. While ensuring the accuracy and integrity of electoral rolls is an essential responsibility of the Election Commission. No eligible citizen is deprived of the opportunity to exercise the franchise due to procedural or administrative shortcomings. I, urge the Government to take note of the concerns raised, engage constructively with all stakeholders, and ensure that the electoral roll revision process is carried out with maximum transparency, adequate public awareness, sufficient time for compliance, accessible grievance redressal mechanisms, and effective safeguards against wrongful exclusion.
records.ls|LS18_S8_6911:
Regarding need to sanction and expedite the detailed project report for Tiruchirapalli metro in Tamil Nadu-laid

SHRI ARUN NEHRU (PERAMBALUR): Tamil Nadu is India?s most industrialized state, accounting for 10.6% of the country's urban population. Despite this rapid urbanization, the state currently has only one operational Metro system. It is imperative that Tier-II cities receive immediate modern infrastructure upgrades. Tiruchirappalli (Trichy) is a critical industrial and educational hub, housing premier institutions, an international airport, and major heavy fabrication units. To manage urban density, where existing roads cannot accommodate future population growth, a modern transit system is essential. Furthermore, an infrastructure push is urgently needed to attract tech companies and generate employment. The public demand is overwhelmingly positive for a Metro network connecting rural peripheries to the city center, ensuring seamless access to colleges, hospitals, and government offices. A Detailed Feasibility Report (DFR) for the Trichy Metro, estimated at ₹10,917 crore, was submitted in August 2023. However, the detailed project report (DPR) remains stalled as priorities have been shifted elsewhere. Therefore, I strongly urge the Union Government, specifically the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, to intervene, coordinate with the State Government, and urgently sanction and expedite the DPR for the Trichy Metro. Tamil Nadu deserves equitable infrastructure distribution to sustain its rapid economic and urban growth.
records.ls|LS18_S8_6912:
Regarding need to establish Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya in Bapatla Parliamentary Constituency, Andhra Pradesh-laid

SHRI KRISHNA PRASAD TENNETI (BAPATLA): I wish to draw the attention of the Government to the need for establishing a Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (JNV) in Bapatla Parliamentary Constituency, Andhra Pradesh. Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas were established with the vision of providing quality residential education to talented children from rural and remote areas, irrespective of their socio-economic background. However, despite this objective, Bapatla?a predominantly rural constituency?still does not have a JNV. The absence of a JNV has limited access to quality education for meritorious students from the constituency, many of whom come from economically and socially disadvantaged families. Around 82% of Bapatla's population lives in rural areas, and nearly 3.59 lakh Scheduled Caste residents constitute about 22% of the population. Establishing a JNV would help bridge learning gaps, provide access to better educational opportunities, and support the implementation of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 by strengthening quality education in underserved regions. Since Bapatla district is not sanctioned with a JNV, I therefore request the Government to approve the establishment of a Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya in my constituency at the earliest so that deserving students from the region can benefit from quality residential education and equal learning opportunities.

श्री श्रीरंग आप्पा चंदू बारणे (मावल) : मेरे संसदीय क्षेत्र मावल एवं कर्जत क्षेत्र पश्चिमी घाट के अत्यधिक वर्षा वाले क्षेत्रों में स्थित हैं । प्रत्येक वर्ष वर्षा ऋतु में अत्यधिक वर्षा होने से इंद्रायणी, पवना, आंद्रा, उल्हास तथा अन्य नदियाँ उफान पर आ जाती हैं । कई बार भारतीय मौसम विभाग (IMD) की पूर्व चेतावनी स्थानीय स्तर पर समय पर उपलब्ध नहीं हो पाती, या पूर्व अनुमान गलत साबित होता है जिससे स्थानीय निवासियों और प्रशासन को प्रभावी तैयारी का अवसर नहीं मिलता । परिणामस्वरूप हर वर्ष बाढ़ से बड़े पैमाने पर जन-धन, कृषि, सड़क, पुल एवं अन्य सार्वजनिक परिसंपत्तियों को भारी नुकसान उठाना पड़ता है । अतः मैं केंद्र सरकार से आग्रह करता हूँ कि मावल एवं कर्जत की सभी नदियों के लिए समग्र रिवर फ्रंट डेवलपमेंट एवं फ्लड मिटिगेशन मास्टर प्लान तैयार किया जाए । इसके अंतर्गत नदी तट सुदृढ़ीकरण, डी-सिल्टिंग, बाढ़ नियंत्रण संरचनाओं का निर्माण तथा आधुनिक अर्ली वार्निंग सिस्टम विकसित किया जाए । साथ ही, इस परियोजना को राष्ट्रीय महत्व की योजना के रूप में स्वीकृति देकर विशेष केंद्रीय पैकेज के अंतर्गत पर्याप्त वित्तीय सहायता उपलब्ध कराई जाए, जिससे क्षेत्र को प्रतिवर्ष आने वाली बाढ़ एवं प्राकृतिक आपदाओं से स्थायी राहत मिल सके तथा पर्यावरण संरक्षण, पर्यटन और स्थानीय विकास को भी बढ़ावा प्राप्त हो ।

Regarding need to restore glorious account of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj in ICSE, State Education Boards, NCERT and CBSE text books-laid

SHRI NILESH DNYANDEV LANKE (AHMEDNAGAR): There is an intense anger and discontentment in Maharashtra due to the extremely inadequate coverage of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj's history in the curriculum prescribed by ICSE, State Education Boards, NCERT and CBSE. A policy decision was adopted by the legislature during the tenure of the then Chief Minister of Maharashtra in 1991, mandating that the history of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj would never be excluded; that decision is now being violated. It is deeply distressing that in CBSE/NCERT textbooks ranging from Class 4 to Class 12, Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj is mentioned in merely 68 words?a fact that deprives future generations of knowledge regarding the glorious deeds of the Maharaj. Furthermore, the history and graph regarding the expansion of the Maratha Empire in the NCERT Class 8 textbook is also excluded. I humbly request the Union Education Minister to look into this serious matter immediately and ensure that a detailed, objective, and glorious account of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj is reinstated in the history textbooks with due honour, and thereby uphold the dignity of Maharashtra's identity.
records.ls|LS18_S8_6916:
Regarding need to sanction Kollengode-Thrissur railway line project in Kerala along with adequate allocation of funds for its timely implementation-laid

SHRI K. RADHAKRISHNAN (ALATHUR): The long-pending demand for the construction of the Kollengode?Thrissur new railway line (Pollachi?Thrissur Chord Line) in Kerala. Of the proposed 89 km railway line, the crucial 54 km stretch between Kollengode and Thrissur remains incomplete. Its completion will reduce the travel distance between Central Kerala and Western Tamil Nadu from 105 km to 53 km, benefiting more than 10 lakh people across 25 village panchayats in the Alathur Parliamentary Constituency and nearby areas. The project will bypass the congested Shoranur and Palakkad junctions, enabling faster passenger and freight movement between Coimbatore, Podanur, Thrissur, and Kochi. It will strengthen cargo connectivity from the industrial centres of Western Tamil Nadu and Tuticorin Port to the Vallarpadam International Container Transshipment Terminal. The railway line will also improve access to important tourist destinations such as Nelliampathy, Pothundi, and Mangalam Dam, promoting tourism, rural development, and employment generation. Furthermore, it will serve as a major pilgrimage corridor connecting Palani, Madurai, and Rameswaram with Thrissur and Guruvayur. Since surveys have already been completed by Southern Railway, I urge the Government to sanction this vital project and allocate adequate funds for its early implementation without further delay.

Regarding need to put in place a standard operating procedure for nationwide rollout of virtual autopsy technology in the country-laid

DR. M. P. ABDUSSAMAD SAMADANI (PONNANI): I would like to draw the attention of the Government to a vital forensic advancement: Virtual Autopsy. Traditional post-mortems cause immense emotional distress to grieving families and pose biological hazards to medical professionals. Virtual autopsy utilizes non-invasive CT scans and MRIs, respecting the deceased's dignity while providing permanent, tamper-proof digital evidence. A pioneering framework already exists at AIIMS New Delhi, where South Asia?s first Advanced Research Centre serves as a national nodal hub processing non-invasive post-mortems. Crucially, Kerala Government has launched a proactive initiative by integrating digital imaging into state medical colleges to modernize regional forensic infrastructure. However, localized initiatives are no longer enough; the time has come for a mandatory nationwide rollout of this technology across all state capitals and district hospitals. To scale these efforts effectively, the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare must establish a national standard operating procedure (SOP). This SOP will standardize operations, from initial scanning in radiolucent bags to final triaging. If the cause of death is clear via 3D imaging, the body can be immediately released. I urge the Ministry to implement this SOP, allocate dedicated central funds, and ensure a countrywide rollout of this dignity-restoring technology.
records.ls|LS18_S8_6918:
Regarding need to take comprehensive measures to stabilize Civil Registration System (CRS) portal for smooth registration of Birth and Death Certificates-laid

SHRI VISHALDADA PRAKASHBAPU PATIL (SANGLI): I wish to draw the attention of the Government to the persistent non-functionality and technical glitches in the Civil Registration System (CRS) portal, which is disrupting the registration of birth and death certificates. Recently, repeated system failures, login issues, and backend processing delays have resulted in the non-issuance or prolonged pendency of certificates. As birth certificates are essential for school admissions, scholarships, and identity documentation, and death certificates are critical for succession, insurance, and welfare claims, these disruptions are causing significant hardship to citizens. The absence of reliable offline alternatives and weak grievance redressal mechanisms has further aggravated the situation, particularly in rural and semi-urban areas where digital access remains limited. This has led to administrative bottlenecks at local bodies and undue delays in delivery of essential public services. I urge the Hon?ble Minister of Home Affairs to undertake an immediate technical audit and stabilisation of the CRS portal infrastructure, provide for updated manual registration mechanisms at district and municipal levels, ensure time-bound clearance of pending applications through special drives and establish a dedicated and accessible grievance redressal system for affected citizens.
